title: Cops & Criminals
description:
The club runs its own law-enforcement system: hauling illicit cargo builds a criminal score, deliveries can make you wanted, police chase and arrest suspects, and jail follows.

<Bold>The loop</>
Deliver illicit cargo to build your <Highlight>criminal score</>. A delivery can randomly trigger <Warning>Wanted</> status. On-duty police see the suspect on their compass and give chase. An arrest means jail plus confiscation of the bounty. Escape the heat and your wanted status decays - pulling that off while cops are on duty pays an evasion bonus.

The system is run by the server itself - no third-party mod involved. Police side: read the Serving as police guide, or duty up with <Highlight>/police</>. Criminal side: see the illicit cargo, criminal score and wanted level guides for the details.

title: Illicit Cargo
description:
Illicit cargo is the drug trade - money pallets are just one cargo among them. Delivering any of these builds your criminal score with 100% of the payment:

<Bold>Ganja line</>
Ganja, Ganja Pallet

<Bold>Coca line</>
Coca Leaves Pallet, Coca Paste, Cocaine, Cocaine Base, Cocaine Bricks, Cocaine Packets, Cocaine Bags, Liquid Cocaine

<Bold>Moonshine line</>
Moonshine, Moonshine Bottles

<Bold>Money line</>
Money, Money Pallet

Legal cargo never touches the score and keeps its subsidies.

<Bold>Money risk premium</>
Money deliveries pay a bonus of 50% of the payment per on-duty officer, up to +250% at five officers. Cash runs are best compensated when police are watching - which is exactly when getting wanted is most dangerous.

title: Criminal Score
description:
Every illicit delivery payment adds 100% of the payment to your criminal score - the single measure of your criminal career.

<Bold>Criminal level</>
level = score / 50,000 + 1 (floored). Check the <Highlight>/criminals</> leaderboard in game - the top 10 players by score, with the server-wide boss marked on rank 1.

<Bold>Score decay</>
The score rots if you stop hauling: 48 hours of grace after your last illicit delivery, then it halves every 7 days. Below $5,000 it clears to zero - a clean slate.

<Bold>The boss tax</>
On every illicit delivery, the server's highest-scoring player takes a cut of 5-20% of your payment. The closer your level is to the boss's, the closer you pay to the 5% floor - the boss taxes newcomers, not his nearest rivals. The cut moves through the bank, works while the boss is offline, and arrives as a private popup.

<Bold>On arrest</>
The confiscated bounty is deducted from your score alongside your wallet - your rap sheet and your money fall together.

title: Wanted Level
description:
Delivering illicit cargo can trigger a random <Warning>Wanted</> status:

<Bold>Trigger odds</>
Any delivery of $1,000,000 or more is wanted outright. Below that, the chance scales with the haul relative to your criminal score - big hauls on a fresh record are risky, a kingpin's small run is nearly safe. Every illicit delivery carries at least a 5% chance. The closer a police officer is when the roll happens, the lower the chance falls (down to the 5% floor) - camping a delivery point farms nothing. Beyond 1 km from any officer the roll runs at full odds.

<Bold>The grace period</>
When a trigger fires you get 30 seconds before you are actually wanted - a private popup asks you to switch to a suitable vehicle. Logging out during those 30 seconds is an unconditional arrest.

<Bold>While wanted</>
You spawn at at least 5 stars, plus one star per full $100,000 of the delivery payment. Stars are a countdown display only. Your bounty is set once at the trigger: 10% of your criminal score, frozen for the whole chase.

The wanted timer decays fastest when you park: the pivot is 50 km/h - above it the timer grows, below it it decays. Distance from police speeds the decay up. With no pressure the status clears in roughly 10 minutes.

<Bold>Evasion</>
If your wanted status runs out while cops are on duty, you evade - and earn up to 10% of your score as a bonus, scaled by how real the chase was. A chase meter builds while you are wanted from the nearest officer's distance (within 1 km) and your speed. A full chase pays the full bonus; nobody getting close pays nothing.

<Bold>Arrest</>
Arrests happen through four paths: a traffic-stop pull-over, logging out within 2 km of an on-duty officer, going underwater while wanted, or entering a teleport portal while wanted. An arrest means the bounty is confiscated from your wallet, the money goes to the treasury with a reward split among on-duty police, and a 60-second jail hold - leaving the 10 m jail perimeter teleports you straight back.
